title.narrative: Trained people found or secured jobs

description.narrative: Number of people (sex/age), reached with skills development and VET programmes supported by this Action found a decent job or secured their job through upskilling.

comment.narrative: A person is considered employed when heshe is 1 15 years or older 2 working formally andor informally 3 wage or selfemployed or working in the family business 4 producing goods andor services 5 generating an income monetary andor inkind through her work. Tracer studies were finalized in five of the six GIZ projects. 1420 graduates found employment of which 548 women 489 youth 549 new jobs 871 secured jobs and 753 decent jobs. This surpasses the target of 1400. 66 of all graduates found employment on average 73 employment per project.
